statement: Let a countable discrete amenable group act on a separable, unital, simple, nuclear, Z-stable C∗-algebra with nonempty tracial-state space. If the action has equivariant uniform property Gamma, it is cocycle conjugate to its tensor product with the trivial action on Z.
